text:
maria: Morning — kicking off a config-only staged unpin for routing + batching tweaks. Change window 05:00-05:30 UTC. Starting canary at 1% traffic. Please watch p95 and kvcache pressure.

deploy-bot: DeployBot started canary 7750012345 for config cfg-early-morn-2026. Phase: 1% -> target 10% after 8m if metrics OK. Smoke tests queued.

leo: Thanks. Can we confirm the rollout increments and the unpin plan for geo-routing? I want 1 -> 10 -> 50 -> 100 over ~25m, not just 1->10->100.

maria: Plan: 1% initial (now), 10% at +8m, 50% at +15m, 100% at +25m. If p95 increases >25% vs baseline or OOM/KV cache pressure spikes, we abort and rollback immediately.

dan: Preflight quick logs:
```
smoketest: ok
canary-smoke: 7/7 PASS
kvcache_free_pct: 81 -> 79 (baseline 82)
p95_latency_ms: 168 -> 175 (baseline 170)
error_rate: 0.02% -> 0.03%
```
Looks safe so far but we should watch tail latencies.

tilly: Set abort conditions: p95 >= 220ms OR error_rate > 0.2% sustained 3m OR kvcache_free_pct drops below 60%. If abort, pin routing to v3 and run rollback job. I'm standing by. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 10% (7750012373). Metric snapshot: p95 176ms, error_rate 0.03%, kvcache_free_pct 78%. No abort triggers.

maria: Noted. Updating release notes and changelog: "config: reduce per-tenant max_batch from 12->8; lower routing timeout 1200ms->900ms; adjust geo shard weights for eu-west spike mitigation."

leo: Add a line in release notes about fallback policy: "automatic fallback to quantized-model-v2 for high latency tenants."

dan: Rollback command if needed: `rbctl rollback cfg-early-morn-2026 && deploybot pin-route --route=global --model=v3` — ops-runbook step 2. Also have `metrics-alert disable` in case of noisy signals.

tilly: Ack. I'll monitor SLO dashboards and paging rules. If I see kv pressure or backend errors, I'll call for immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary complete 100% at 7750012410. No aborts. Final metrics: p95 170ms, error_rate 0.03%, kvcache_free_pct 80%.

maria: Great — rolling release notes finalized and pushed. Post-deploy checklist: monitor next 2h for regressions, keep canary tag for 24h, and leave pinned rollback command in the thread. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
